niche_label_CORRECTION_to_B.verdict: B repeated the SAME niche-inference error already flagged on ZF-G12: it reverse-engineered RN-labels from feeder-DB names. The relational data type ZF-S4 needs does NOT map cleanly onto any single existing data-niche.
niche_label_CORRECTION_to_B.RESOLVED_2026-07-21: HUMAN GATE (Emmanuel: 'RN11 primario') -> ADR-0042. Placement: mutant->phenotype table = RN11 primary (curated claims; each row is a genotype->phenotype penetrance claim; ZFIN is a curated DB); genetic-interaction edges (BioGRID, already-registered feeder of RN3/RN12) = corroborating edges/entities, NOT a separate niche; isogenic variance = RN1/RN9. RN12 does NOT apply (generated perturbation designs only). NO new niche opened; a first-class relational niche (RN14) is DEFERRED until S4 is selected AND the relational structure proves load-bearing (would then need its own ADR + composite-audit per the ADR-0018 bar). Relational-structure limitation carried as a gap_flag.

generation_commission_AFTER_ingest.note: Once the relational layer is ingested, THIS becomes a clean generation commission for B:
generation_commission_AFTER_ingest.task: Decompose penetrance variance into genetic (hidden modifiers) / developmental-stochastic (isogenic floor) / micro-environmental components; test whether adding GRN topology beats an additive-genetics baseline on OUT-OF-SAMPLE (held-out) prediction under an E_sparse penalty.
must_carry: observable: penetrance/expressivity as a PROBABILITY (not a point phenotype)
comparison (#2): GRN-topology model vs additive-genetics baseline, on a real HELDOUT split
candidate_falsifier: GRN-topology fails held-out CV against additive genetics, OR isogenic variance shows the 'predictable' component is irreducible noise
external-verifier enforces the holdout (guards published-phenotype leakage); calibration owns the ECE/Test-4 scoring
generation_commission_AFTER_ingest.coherence_trap_to_honor (from B's own ba: A point-prediction counted as a hit when the true target is a PROBABILITY; and fitting to PUBLISHED phenotypes leaks the answer (data contamination). The holdout is mandatory.
